# FieldhouseUSA

> FieldhouseUSA is a private, commercial indoor sports complex and event venue at 14200 E Alameda Ave, Aurora, CO 80012, serving the Denver metro area. It has 15 volleyball courts in seven zones (Zones 1 to 4 convert to 4 basketball courts or 12 pickleball courts; Zone 7 converts to one futsal arena), two studios for dance and yoga, a bar and kitchen (Oda Up), a mezzanine and free on-site parking. It is not a city recreation center.

Email: admin@aurorafieldhouseusa.com.

## Key facts
- Special events (birthdays, corporate events, galas, fundraisers) are booked through Event-Den: https://event-den.com/
- Tournaments: directors rent a pod of courts or the whole building. Dates book 6 to 8 months ahead. All rentals require a signed rental contract. A 30% deposit holds the dates. The balance is due at least 30 days before the event.
- Drop-in volleyball: Thursday through Monday, 7 PM to 11 PM, run by Boomtown Athletics.
- No outside food or drink is allowed in the building. Everyone is subject to a bag search.
- Service animals are allowed with advance notice so a reasonable accommodation can be arranged. Animals are not allowed on playing surfaces.
- There is no lost and found. Lost items are not the facility's responsibility.
- Open space: about 32,000 sq ft of open floor with the nets raised, 8,000 sq ft expo spaces, an 8,000 sq ft gala space, two studios (1,500 and 2,000 sq ft), a 3,000 sq ft lounge and dining area, and a full bar and restaurant.

## Service operator partners
- Event-Den (Special events): Private parties, corporate events, galas and fundraisers, including the mezzanine. https://event-den.com/
- Oda Up (Special events): Bar, kitchen and event catering inside the fieldhouse. https://odaup.com/
- Social-Den (Special events): Lounge, workspace and meeting room.
- Boomtown Athletics (Volleyball): Adult leagues, drop-in, tournaments and training. https://www.boomtownathletics.com/
- Colorado Boom (Volleyball): Junior club volleyball, tryouts and club training. https://coloradoboom.com/
- Shoot 360 Denver (Basketball): Shot-tracking bays, skills training and memberships. https://www.shoot360denver.com/
- Team Evo (Basketball): Youth basketball club. https://teamevo.org/
- Real Colorado (Futsal): Youth futsal. https://www.realcolorado.net/
- VOLO Sports (Social leagues and community): Adult social sports leagues. https://www.volosports.com/
- Match Point Social (Social leagues and community): Social sports and community events. https://www.matchptsocial.com/
- Colorado Athletics Foundation (Social leagues and community): Scholarships, sponsorship and youth access to sport. https://coloradoaf.org/
- Dance-Den (Studios and wellness): Dance classes and studio time in the studios. https://aurorafieldhouseusa.com/studios.html#dance-den
- Yoga-Den (Studios and wellness): Yoga and mobility classes in the studios. https://aurorafieldhouseusa.com/studios.html#yoga-den
- Therapy / Spa Room (Studios and wellness): Sports therapy and recovery, by appointment.

## Tour stops
- Main entrance and front desk: Through the main doors with the admin desk on your right. Check in for your event, sign the waiver and ask where to go.
- Shoot 360: Inside the Shoot 360 lab: shooting bays that track every shot, and a skills court.
- Hardwood Courts: Four hardwood zones, seen from the aisle between Zones 1 and 3. They convert between volleyball, basketball and pickleball.
- Social Den: Seating, workspace and a meeting room between the studios and the bar.
- Bar and kitchen: Oda Up runs the bar and kitchen in the middle of the floor, with seating beside Zone 6. Alcohol stays in the bar seating area.
- Studio 1: The smaller studio beside the bar, for small classes, team recovery and private sessions.
- Studio 2: The larger studio, used for dance, yoga and mobility classes.
- Mezzanine: An upper deck that looks down over the courts. Private hire for receptions, watch parties and corporate days.
- Sports Court: A sports court with two volleyball courts beside the bar, with courtside seating.
- Sports Court and Futsal Arena: A sports court with three volleyball courts in a row, or one futsal arena.
